## Approvals

Approvals are comments or reviews on this PR, never chat messages:

- Plan: the tech lead comments `/approve-plan <sha>` for the current PR head. A bare `/approve-plan` does not count.
- Gate: the tech lead comments `/approve-gate <G> <sha>`, or approves the PR head in a review.
- A plan approval covers the story file from `## Story` down to `## Ledger`: code pushes and Ledger notes keep it, and any change above `## Ledger` resets it. A gate approval is for one head sha: any new commit resets it.
